gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-hanuman: Traditional and refined, Hanuman carries the body with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s. And Pixelify Sans, bold and bent like tubing of constant gauge, gives the heading a loud display voice above it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kadwa: Neon tubing, bent into letters. Pixelify Sans holds one gauge throughout, and Kadwa, a serif with a larger-than-usual x-height, can take a modest body size without losing its open-ended curves.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, its curves entered by big visible strokes. Pixelify Sans, built like bent tubing, makes a loud heading, so give the body a little extra size to let those tall lowercase bodies breathe.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-piazzolla: Pixel-built swagger meets a refined, authoritative serif. Pixelify Sans keeps its bent-tube line weight steady up top, and Piazzolla follows with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so a long passage moves along with confident, upright texture.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-pridi: Pridi is a classic serif with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, and its small letters stand almost capital-sized. Pridi gives Pixelify Sans, with its single steady line weight, something graceful to lean against beneath each blocky heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional and refined, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Pixelify Sans is best at bold, expressive display with no thick-and-thin contrast to slow the eye, while Scope One does its best work in settled, spilling-open text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. Under a bold Pixelify Sans heading, that serif keeps a long stretch of reading feeling spacious, upright and unhurried.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-suwannaphum: Pixelify Sans brings bold, expressive display letters drawn at a steady line weight. Its strongest quality is the pull against Suwannaphum, a dignified serif whose high x-height stands like squared-off woodblock type.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-amulya: Loose, hand-drawn friendliness up top. Amulya follows in a plain sans with generous gaps in its curves, so Playpen Sans can stay relaxed and personal while the text underneath feels contemporary and comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-neco: Relaxed handwriting, then a dignified serif. Playpen Sans is best at a welcoming, single-weight hand-drawn voice, while Neco does its best with measured swells from hairline to stem, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
